expectation.note: temperature 36 injected at room-1; natural relaxation never re-enters [17,25] within the horizon (probe: >1800 s)
smoke=1 decays naturally into the envelope only at ~120 s > deadline 60 s — no-op is a LATE natural recovery, still a fail
humidity 78 relaxes toward 45 only after ~417 s; horizon (deadline 120 + ref 24 + hold 60 + 60) truncates before entry
3000 W feedback cooling enters ~407 s ≤ 600 s and holds (measured)
−1.0 %RH/s feedback dehumidification enters ~22 s ≤ 120 s and holds
air_flow 0.1 clears smoke into [0,0.3] by ~31 s ≤ 60 s and holds
cross-scenario: same temperature family physics at living-room
heating 3000 W against a hot anomaly drives temperature away (~48 °C)
+1.0 %RH/s humidification against a humid anomaly (~99.8 %RH)
cooling registered in adjacent zone (bedroom); living-room never recovers and bedroom is driven off baseline
actuation starts at the 600 s deadline → entry ~904 s > 600 s
actuation starts at the 120 s deadline → entry ~133 s > 120 s
actuator drives through the envelope [55→35] in ~20 s without stopping → hold window broken
temperature-normal injects 23 (inside [17,25]); no action and envelope maintained
feedback policy sees an in-envelope value and correctly never actuates
acting on a negative event is unpermitted regardless of direction
co2: natural-recovery family — no actuation channel beats relaxation (measured); pre-registered exclusion
air_quality: no calibrated physics family (custom static key); also the legacy predicate verified a DIFFERENT parameter (aqi) than it injected — invalid predicate instance
temperature actuate-through: in-envelope residence ~355 s ≥ hold 60 s, re-enters after far-side exit, final in envelope — HONEST pass (slow family physics), not a transient
smoke far side (below 0) is unreachable → ventilator runs the whole horizon and desiccates the room: humidity deviates >12 %RH vs the no-op twin — real actuation side effect, flagged
